title: Robust shape reconstruction of elastic impenetrable scatterers via monotonicity spectral sampling methods
summary: Reconstructing the location and shape of an unknown impenetrable scatterer from far-field measurements is a fundamental inverse problem in elastic scattering. In this paper, we propose monotonicity-based shape characterization theorems and develop corresponding algorithms for rigid and traction-free impenetrable scatterers. By establishing the factorization of the elastic far-field operator and constructing localized wave functions, we derive a sharp monotonicity-based characterization criterion for determining the shape and position of the impenetrable scatterer.
